orig: ネバーアフターダーク
ov: لا شيء بعد حلول الظلام (اليابانية: ネバーアフターダーク) هو فلم رعب خارق للطبيعة ياباني، من تأليف وإخراج ديف بويل. ومن بطولة مويكا هوشي بدور آيري، وهي وسيطة روحية تمتلك القدرة على التواصل مع الأرواح العالقة في مكان ما وطردها. تُستأجر آيري لإخراج روح خطيرة من منزل منعزل، لكنها تكشف أسراراً مظلمة خلال مهمتها. يضم طاقم التمثيل أيضاً كورومي إيناغاكي وكينتو كاكو وتاي كيمورا وبوكوزو ماسانا. عُرض الفلم في دور السينما في 25 سبتمبر 2026 من توزيع شركة ماغنوليا بيكتشرز.
plotEn:
A young woman named Airi works as a wandering spiritual medium, hired by the living to exorcise ghosts. She is assisted in her duties by the ghost of her older sister, Miku, who died as a young girl.   
Airi arrives at a remote bed and breakfast which is owned by widow Teiko. Teiko claims to have encountered a ghost around the property, and asks that Airi gets rid of it. Her son Gunji is skeptical of his mother and suspects Airi of scamming them. To their disappointment, Airi requests they vacate the property while she works, and tells them she will never work at night, since the veil between the spirit and physical world is too thin.  
Guided by Miku, Airi encounters the ghost, a man with a gruesome mouth injury. The ghost pays little attention to Airi and is fixated on searching a room for something. Investigating, Airi discovers a box filled with human teeth. Miku grows wary of the spirit and requests that Airi leaves, but Airi assures her it will be an ordinary job. A suspicious Gunji arrives that night to check on Airi and the two bond over music. The following day, Airi enters the spirit world to communicate with the ghost, but is shocked when he turns aggressive and chases her. Airi narrowly escapes him, returning to the real world. Inspecting the teeth, Airi is disturbed to receive flashes of murder victims having their teeth removed.
